method: In-page window.fetch shim (scripts/f1d-shim.js): 2.5–8 s latency, synthetic list mocks, synthetic 500s, and every non-GET /api request blocked (no data mutation; nothing sent to the LLM). Flash detection via MutationObserver (scripts/f1d-watch.js); PerformanceObserver longtask/layout-shift; rAF scroll probe. fetch restored and both sessions closed at the end.
